name: information as bartered territory inducing recursive territorial self improvement
asks: One of the strangest things here conceptually is the idea of information as geometric territory that is constantly bartered for passage through, AND that the passage can cause change in the territory, inducing a recursive self-improvement of patches of territory. The math here is truly well beyond what you can grok, which is part of why it needs to be provided as a service when "more math" is the thing that needs to be bought, lol. [emsenn, session of 2026-07-16, multi-idea prompt on Rendanheyi EMC formalization]
